title: 'Walang imposible:' Fajardo still hopeful as San Miguel fights for survival in PBA Governors' Cup
summary: Nine-time PBA Most Valuable Player June Mar Fajardo remains hopeful even as the San Miguel Beermen are facing elimination in the PBA Season 50 Governors’ Cup quarterfinals.
